name: ChartTooltip
description:
The floating readout for multi-series and per-mark charts: a glass overlay that follows the
pointer (or the keyboard cursor) and lists every series at that position — values lead,
labels follow, each keyed by a short line of the series colour. It is portalled to the
body (an overlay is never a blurred layer inside the panel's blurred layer, R4.2), carries
the plot's mode and palette islands, and never takes the pointer.
signature: ({ store, anchor, children }: ChartTooltipProps): import("react").ReactPortal | null

props.name: anchor
props.description: The plot, for its mode/palette island.

props.name: children
props.description: Build the content for a hover; return null for none.

props.description: External store observed by the component.
